contradictions.description: F1 says power was lost at 02:14 but F10 timeline shows the alarm at 02:41
F3 says service restored at 06:34 (4h20m outage per F4) but F15 says utility feed restored at 08:05
F5 says 312 customers affected but F19 says 213
F6 says Priya Raman approved the failover but F12 says Daniel Okafor
F2 says the UPS carried the load for 15 minutes but F11 says 9 minutes (F17 is only the rating, not a conflict)
F18 says roughly 11 hours of runtime but F21 says 20 percent, about 3 hours
F7 says a storm triggered the fault but F23 says clear skies and F24 says a transformer failure at Substation 7
F19 says 41 premium customers but F25 says 38
